purpose: Offline benchmark-only action-level text admission prototype and verification. Reuses 96 prior real trials (24 seed clusters), 336 model-choice route states and all 5576 action candidates; no new real provider model or remote ASR requests. Existing 42 registered runtime sources and all 68 prior artifacts remain byte-identical. Local actual Sherpa and loopback model E2E are implementation checks, not new model-quality evidence. Captured visual-choice compatibility is a mechanical rule counterfactual, not a Jev answer, success, latency, image-call saving or adoption measurement. Standard TAR hardlinks deduplicate identical bytes while retaining every member path/hash/original stat.

final_metadata.analysis_digest_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(analysis-output-sha256.json decoded object, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=False); the object maps all 7 canonical output paths to file SHA256.
final_metadata.runtime_scope: Benchmark-only new subclass plus existing test file. No factory/config/default changes, original 42 frozen sources byte-identical. Current live runner/audit not wired to new policy.
final_metadata.model_quality_scope: Mechanical rule opportunity and compatibility of captured visual choices only; no new Jev prediction, completion, latency, image savings, fees, causal, confirmatory or adoption evidence.
limitations: All 336 denominator steps had already reached model choice; pre-call observation/candidate-limit failures are outside this replay.
Uniqueness does not prove goal correctness; negative states can still offer unique irrelevant actions.
Additional Jev attempts may increase total latency when visual fallback remains necessary.
Full backend result retains its 1 skip and 21 warnings.
All failed/interrupted attempts and abandoned shared extraction versions retained.
final_metadata.archive_note: Contains reviewed source/docs snapshots, input bindings and selected captures, all analysis versions, tests/verification logs and reviewer evidence. Ephemeral reviewer UV cache excluded; no source/input/result evidence excluded. Following plan lifecycle/archive-pointer/signature updates do not alter reviewed implementation or canonical data.
